edits.before: Changing or adding a merge ref (other than its letter case) joins every queue of the claim again at the back.
edits.after: Changing or adding a merge ref (other than its letter case) joins every queue of the claim again at the back. Where the resident CI runs, it may also put the claim into the default branch's queue itself (`merge:<owner>/<name>:main`, at the back) once it has admitted the current head of the pull request the claim is bound to, and extend the claim's lease while its CI runs, never past the hard deadline. Neither changes your `fence`, `lease_version`, `progress_ref` or renewal count, so your renewals stay valid. A renewal whose `trigger_refs` leave out the merge ref the CI added keeps that ref and your place, and a renewal never shortens a longer lease the CI gave: it sets the later of the current expiry and 2 hours from now, within the hard deadline.

edits.before: leave the queue then or when you stop: renew without the ref or release the claim
edits.after: leave the queue then or when you stop: renew without the ref or release the claim (a renewal keeps a merge ref the CI added, so then release the claim)
